title: UpdateWorkItemRequest
description: Payload to update a work item's status, result, or data

id.description: Unique identifier of the work item to update

queueId.description: ID of the queue containing the work item

version.description: Current optimistic locking version number (must match server value)

status.description: New processing status for the work item

result.description: Processing result to record on the work item

json.description: Updated data payload for the work item
